title: Is this why the backrooms creepypasta is so popular?

classification.theory_summary: Proposes that Backrooms/liminal spaces feel familiar because many people have seen similar liminal spaces in dreams (including Mall World-type dreams), even if forgotten, and that this subconscious recognition contributes to Backrooms popularity.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative, locations, or events described—only a general theory about liminal spaces and Mall World-type dreams.

meta.author_theory: Backrooms popularity may come from subconscious recognition of similar liminal spaces seen in dreams (Mall World-type dreams), even if the dreams are forgotten; the 'weird feelings' when viewing liminal spaces may be dream-memory recall.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no first-person dream report content; only references to 'liminal spaces' and 'mall world type dreams' in general without describable phenomenology (light, layout, entities, actions, etc.).
